notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Update Patch Notes

New & Improved!

- More Checkpoints in Easy Mode. Practice just got smoother! We've added extra checkpoints to make 
your experience more accessible and frustration-free.
- Coins Now Save on Collection. No more losing your hard-earned coins! They are now properly saved 
once collected.
- Collision Update. Touch the ground, even with a foot? You're out! This improves game fairness and consistency.
- Improved Friction & Braking. No more unintended sliding! We've fine-tuned movement to give you better control on all surfaces.

Fixes & Optimizations

- Multiplayer Title Replication Fixed. Titles now display correctly for all players.
- Countdown Bug Fixed. The countdown timer now behaves properly after matches start.
- Private Sessions No Longer Appear in Search. Hidden lobbies stay hidden as intended.
- Various Visual & Sound Fixes. A smoother, more immersive experience with multiple tweaks and improvements.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Happy jumping!

notes.title: Easy Mode Just Got Easier
notes.notes:
We've made some tweaks to improve your experience in JUMP! The floor is...:

 - Easy Mode is now even easier! More checkpoints have been added, making it much simpler to complete levels.
 - Coin Collection Update! Coins are now saved immediately when you collect them, rather than only at checkpoints. No more lost progress!
 - And More! We’ve made other fixes and improvements, be sure to check the full patch notes for all the details!

 Reminder: Easy Mode is for practice only! It doesn’t grant rewards, and trophies earned here won’t count toward your total.

 Big Update Coming Soon! Stay tuned for exciting new content! 👀

notes.title: JUMP! The Floor Is... LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your incredible support! This is just the beginning of our journey, and we’re committed to improving the game and bringing you regular updates to make it even better.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please don’t hesitate to let us know! You can report them in our Steam Community Bug Report Thread or on our Discord Server.

Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we can’t wait to hear what you think. Let’s make this adventure amazing together!

Thank you,
GamesDoc
